title: H-SALEHOLE-1 part 2 ('Option 2'): inside a merger-FLIPPED partner shop (a GYM, whose NPC sales never pass Order.Pay, so nothing can ever forward) the NON-OWNER member simulates and the owner books nothing; the moment the OWNER walks in, the election must hand the live customers to HIM - his machine holds the books, so every sale books natively there - and hand them back when he leaves. Ends dissolved; NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Build with the H-SALEHOLE-1 instruments (the budgeted [Customers] seed verdict line and the `salestats` lever) deployed on BOTH machines. THE SHOP IS DISCOVERED AT RUNTIME: after the merger forms, the HOST's `mergestatus` keys[0] is a building the CLIENT truly owns and the flip has made look like the host's own - that is the shop the non-owner member walks into. The CLIENT is the owner throughout and the HOST is the non-owner member (the mirror of the brief's first choice, because `mergestatus keys` is the only runtime discovery lever and on the host it names the client's buildings). THE FIXTURE SHOP IS A GYM: its NPC sales complete through Customer.CompleteOrder and never reach Order.Pay, so forwardedSent/adopted can only ever be 0 on this shop - the two old forward oracles are capture-only here. Stock and staff are recorded from the fixture at steps 16-19 rather than required: if the shop turns out to be empty or shut, the salestats captures still say so. NOTHING is saved.

OPENING HOURS: the fixture loads at day 133, 12:00, so 15:00 is forward and inside ordinary retail hours. The lever only moves the clock FORWARD, so an ERR here means the world was already past 15:00 - the run continues and the salestats captures say whether customers came.

ORACLE 1: the member is standing in a shop it believes it rents and the sync layer knows it does not own
ORACLE 2: with the owner OUTSIDE, the non-owner member is the elected live-customer simulator - unchanged by this round's rule, which only fires while the owner is inside
ORACLE 3: the member's shopper table for the partner's shop holds the owner's schedule (the part-1 seed)
ORACLE 4: at least one entry here carries an owner-minted id

CAPTURE ONLY (was oracle 5). A GYM cannot forward: its NPC sales complete through Customer.CompleteOrder and never pass Order.Pay, which is the only place Patch_Order_Pay_HelperForward can fire. forwardedSent=0 here is CORRECT, not a defect - that is exactly why the owner has to simulate.
CAPTURE ONLY (was oracle 6): with nothing forwarded there is nothing to adopt. Recorded so the run says so in numbers.

ORACLE H2 - LAST CHECKPOINT of this leg: the member's REPLICA of the owner's till queue must not have moved while the member simulated (nothing may be booked into the partner's replica on this machine). Compared against the first checkpoint, step 28.
